title: 7th Be Forever Yamato: Rebel 3199 Film Reveals Title, Visual, October 30 Premiere
content: Bandai Namco Filmworks revealed on Friday that the seventh film in Yamato yo Towa ni: Rebel 3199 ( Be Forever Yamato : Rebel 3199), the latest project in the Space Battleship Yamato remakes, is titled Nijiiro no Rinne (Rainbow-Colored Reincarnation) and will open in theaters in Japan on October 30.
author: ANN

title: 5 Years Later, Solo Leveling Shares First Official Look At The Sequel
content: Solo Leveling premiered its intense Season 2 in 2025 and adapted the best arc of the entire story. However, the anime still hasn’t shared any updates on its return as of yet. While there are several rumors about the story’s continuation, nothing can be confirmed before the official update.
author: ComicBook

title: The Dangers in My Heart Movie to Stream on HIDIVE from July 14
content: The Dangers in My Heart: The Movie will officially begin streaming on HIDIVE starting on July 14, with both English dub and sub versions available. The film premiered in Japan on February 13, while HIDIVE brought it to the US soon after on February 16 (subtitled) and February 18 (English dub).
author: Anime Corner

title: Netflix’s Best Horror Anime Confirms an Official New Release For Fans Ahead of Season 2
content: Last summer, Netflix debuted the anime adaptation of Mokumokuren’s award-winning horror manga, The Summer Hikaru Died . The manga has several awards under its belt, including the Traditional Chinese Global Special Prize at the eighth Tsugi ni Kuru Manga Awards in 2022.
author: ComicBook

title: 5 Berserk Fights We’re Dying to See As The End Approaches
content: 2026 is a big year for Berserk , even without a new anime adaptation planned to hit the screen. After waiting for nearly a year, the bleak manga series finally returned to the pages of Young Animal, as writer Kouji Mori and Studio Gaga’s artists have released chapter 384 of the series.
author: ComicBook

content: While the exciting Summer 2026 anime season is closer than ever, the beloved Spring shows are reaching their season finales one after the other. title: Crunchyroll to Stream Kagurabachi Anime
content: Crunchyroll announced on Thursday that it will stream the television anime adaptation of Takeru Hokazono 's Kagurabachi manga in April 2027 worldwide excluding Japan, Mainland China, North Korea, and South Korea. The staff also revealed that Katsuyuki Konishi will play Togo Shiba.
author: ANN

title: All 8 Pokemon Movies & TV Shows Coming to Free Streaming on Tubi in July
content: The Summer 2026 anime season is right around the corner, and fans are all set to welcome the new films and shows of the season. While Crunchyroll again steals the spotlight for streaming a majority of the new anime shows, other services also have a range of surprises planned for fans.
author: ComicBook

title: Cyberpunk Edgerunners 2 Introduces First Character Weak Kingsley, Teases Announcement for June 29
content: Studio TRIGGER has introduced the first character, Weak Kingsley, for the CYBERPUNK EDGERUNNERS 2 sequel anime . Fans at the Annecy International Animation Film Festival had the chance to see a teaser earlier this week, while the broader announcement is scheduled for June 29.
author: Anime Corner
